assessment.nobel_worthiness: Visionary, densely patterned prose in which memory, the body and cosmology become one metaphysical project. The long Blinding project and Solenoid suggest a voice with few close parallels, strong formal ambition and real imaginative depth. The scale of the architecture and the linguistic density are the main grounds for ranking him first under common criteria of voice, form and depth.
assessment.attribution: A single-writer citation is clean. It would centre on the prose fiction, with the poetry as context, and on the creation of an idiosyncratic Romanian-language imaginative universe that merges the intimate with the encyclopedic.
assessment.maturity: Decades of sustained work from poetry through the large novels, with a consistent obsessive world rather than a single peak. The timing is plausible for a writer with a substantial completed core.
uncertainties: Much of the effect depends on Romanian prose texture, rhythm and long-sentence control, which translation may flatten.
Judgments rest on public knowledge of the major works and not on a full reading of the corpus.
The late novels may be uneven or excessive in length, and I cannot verify this.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: A rigorously inward fiction with an unmistakable voice. Systems of landscape, mental images, memory and syntax are built with extreme control and self-scrutiny, in The Plains, Border Districts and related books. Its formal radicalism is achieved through restraint rather than spectacle.
assessment.attribution: Clear single-author scope: a late-career body of fiction that makes its own epistemology of memory and the mind's imagery. The citation could be precise about this self-reflexive method.
assessment.maturity: A long career in which the later works deepen and refine the earlier premises. The oeuvre is compact and consistent, and its quality seems sustained, though its range is deliberately narrow.
uncertainties: The narrow thematic range may limit the claim to wide significance across a body of work.
The effect depends on exact English syntax, so how it would read in translation is uncertain.
I have not read the complete corpus and rely on public knowledge of the best-known works.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Grotesque, mythic and satirical forms confront ideology, development and collective violence. The Four Books and The Explosion Chronicles show an inventive attempt at a distinctive narrative grammar, which the author has called mythorealism. The imaginative range is broad and the moral seriousness considerable.
assessment.attribution: A single-writer citation would concern fiction, with essays as support. It would turn on the invention of a narrative mode for modern Chinese history, which is more than documentary or political testimony.
assessment.maturity: A large oeuvre over several decades with evolving formal strategies. The sustained quality across all of it is harder to judge from my partial knowledge.
uncertainties: Chinese-language stylistic achievement is hard to judge through translation.
Political suppression and its symbolism must not substitute for literary merit; the case should rest on the texts.
Quality may vary among a large number of titles, and I cannot verify this.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: A major renewing force in modern Arabic poetry, which he remade through myth, fragmentation and a critical dialogue with inherited forms. Songs of Mihyar the Damascene and A Time Between Ashes and Roses are central. The case is strong on formal and linguistic achievement and on intellectual depth.
assessment.attribution: A citation could cover poetry and critical essays that reconsider the Arabic tradition. Separating the poetic achievement from his role as a cultural theorist and public intellectual would need care.
assessment.maturity: A very long career with sustained influence and a coherent poetic project. The durability is well supported, and the issue is how well it carries into other languages.
uncertainties: Classical Arabic prosody and intertextual density are difficult to convey in translation, so my assessment is necessarily partial.
His public political positions should not shape the literary judgment.
Judgments of the late work rest on limited public knowledge.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Compressed, highly wrought French prose turns obscure lives and art history into narrative inquiry. Small Lives and The Eleven are widely admired for the intensity of their sentences and the concentration of their form. Voice and linguistic achievement are the strongest grounds.
assessment.attribution: A clear single-writer case based on a small number of exacting works. The citation would stress the fusion of fiction, biography and art-historical imagination.
assessment.maturity: The oeuvre is slim but consistent. The question is whether its modest scale supports the breadth of significance that the will implies.
uncertainties: The limited volume of work raises the question of scope across a body of work.
The prose style is very language-dependent and may not survive translation fully.
My knowledge of the less-known shorter books is thin.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Hybrid works that remake the boundaries between classical scholarship, lyric, narrative and visual form. Autobiography of Red and Nox are inventive and emotionally forceful. The intellectual depth and formal daring are high, and the voice is recognisable.
assessment.attribution: A citation could cover poetry and hybrid forms rooted in the classics. The role of translation and scholarly work within the oeuvre would have to be defined so that it is clear what is being assessed.
assessment.maturity: A substantial career of continuing formal experiment. It is hard to say whether the later work consolidates or only repeats the early breakthroughs.
uncertainties: The weight of genre-crossing, scholarship and performance work against the core poetry is uncertain.
Some work depends on visual and material form that is hard to assess in text alone.
I rely on public knowledge of the principal books and not on a comprehensive reading.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: A desert cosmology that joins Tuareg experience, ecological limits and metaphysical fiction. Gold Dust and The Bleeding of the Stone give myth and landscape serious imaginative weight. The voice and subject are distinct within Arabic fiction.
assessment.attribution: A single-writer citation would stress a sustained fictional world built in Arabic from Saharan Tuareg culture. The oeuvre is large, and its exact scope would need to be defined.
assessment.maturity: Decades of work with a consistent vision. The depth is plausible, though the allegorical method may produce repetition across many books.
uncertainties: Translation coverage is uneven, so I cannot assess the whole oeuvre or the quality of its Arabic prose.
The ecological and allegorical themes may be more striking than the individual works are accomplished.
My assessment rests on public knowledge of a few titles.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Meditative prose and moral interiority bring theology, family and American history into dialogue. Housekeeping and Gilead show a very distinct voice with great linguistic control and quiet intellectual depth.
assessment.attribution: A citation would centre on a small body of novels, with essays as a secondary strand of argument. The distinction between literary achievement and the essays' public or religious positions would need to be kept clear.
assessment.maturity: The fiction is limited in quantity, though its quality is consistently high. The question is whether the number of novels is enough for a full-oeuvre judgment.
uncertainties: A relatively small fictional corpus limits the claim of breadth.
How the essays and theological writing should weigh in the assessment is uncertain.
Her late novels may deepen or repeat the Gilead world, and I cannot judge this with certainty.
